proposals.before: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.
proposals.after: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
proposals.reason: Chinese 和世㻋 is Khoshila/Qosila (Mingzong's personal name), not Arig Temür.

proposals.before: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.
proposals.after: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
proposals.reason: Same correction as idiomatic: 和世㻋 should be Khoshila, not Arig Temür.

proposals.before: First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
proposals.after: Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天歷二年 is the second year of Tianli (AD 1329), not the first.

proposals.before: First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
proposals.after: Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天歷二年 is the second year of Tianli, mistranslated as first year.

proposals.before: Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.
proposals.after: Hanlin academician-director Tangut was promoted to grand marshal.
proposals.reason: Chinese 太尉 is grand marshal/commandant, not grand preceptor (太師); name 唐兀 matches earlier Tangut.

proposals.before: Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.
proposals.after: Hanlin academician-director Tangut was promoted to grand marshal.
proposals.reason: 太尉 ≠ grand preceptor; align name with 唐兀 Tangut.

proposals.before: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat associate administrator Qabildar together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
proposals.after: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
proposals.reason: Chinese 哈八兒禿 is Qabarqu (already named earlier), not Qabildar; 平章政事 is grand councillor.

proposals.before: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
proposals.after: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
proposals.reason: Chinese 臣也不倫 uses 臣 as 'your subject'; the personal name is 也不倫 (Yebulun), not Chenye Bulun.

proposals.before: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
proposals.after: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
proposals.reason: 臣 is a memorial self-reference, not part of the name 也不倫.

proposals.before: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
proposals.after: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天厯 is Tianli (天歷), not Tianshun.

proposals.before: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
proposals.after: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
proposals.reason: 天厯/天歷 should be Tianli, not Tianshun.

decisions.reason: s0001 諱和世㻋 is Mingzong's personal name Khoshila; Arig Temür is unsupported by the Chinese.
The same 諱和世㻋 requires Khoshila in the literal field; Arig Temür is a false personal name.
s0043 opens 天歷二年正月乙丑; 二年 is the second year of Tianli, not the first.
Literal likewise misreads 天歷二年 as first year; Second year of Tianli restores the Chinese date.
s0117 加翰林學士承旨唐兀為太尉: 唐兀 is Tangut and 太尉 is grand marshal, not Tangqutu/grand preceptor (太師).
The literal has the same errors: 唐兀→Tangut and 太尉→grand marshal, matching chapter usage of both terms.
s0161 中書平章政事哈八兒禿 is central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu; Qabildar and associate administrator misread name and office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 中書平章政事哈八兒禿

decisions.reason: s0168 知樞密院事臣也不倫: 臣 is the memorial self-reference; the name is 也不倫 (Yebulun), not Chenye Bulun.
The literal likewise absorbs 臣 into the name; Yebulun correctly separates the honorific from 也不倫.
s0171 天厯二年 is the Tianli (天歷) era, not Tianshun; the proposed era name correction is accurate.
Literal likewise misreads 天厯 as Tianshun; Tianli restores the era named in the annotation.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows Arig Temür was invented by the bad taboo-name rendering; s0001 supports only 和世㻋 (already claimed as Khoshila).
Accepted r0007 shows Qabildar came only from the bad idiomatic of 哈八兒禿; the unit supports Qabarqu, already claimed.
Accepted r0008 shows Chenye Bulun fused memorial 臣 into the name; s0168 supports only 也不倫 (Yebulun).

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0005 restores English Tangut for 唐兀; Tangqutu was a bad reading of the same Chinese name, so the claim value must change while keeping id, subject, predicate, zh, certainty, and evidence.
